title: Cognyte Named as a Sample Vendor in the 2026 Gartner® Navigate Executive Threat Protection Solutions Against Evolving AI Threats
summary: Cognyte is named as a Sample Vendor in Gartner research on executive threat protection. See what AI-driven threats to executives mean for security leaders.
body_markdown:
## TL;DR


- Cognyte is named as a Sample Vendor in the Gartner® Navigate Executive Threat Protection Solutions Against Evolving AI Threats report, published 5 November 2026.
- Cognyte’s external threat intelligence solution, LUMINAR, is named in the Social Media and Dark Web Monitoring category.
- The recognition follows Cognyte’s inclusion in Gartner® research on cyberthreat intelligence in 2024 and preemptive cybersecurity in 2025.
- Executive threat protection covers leaked credentials and personal data, impersonation, account takeover and deepfake-enabled fraud aimed at leaders.


We are thrilled to share that LUMINAR, Cognyte’s external threat intelligence solution, has been named as a Sample Vendor in a new Gartner® report Navigate Executive Threat Protection Solutions Against Evolving AI Threats, published November 5, 2026, by analysts Elizabeth Kim and Mitchell Schneider. Cognyte’s external threat intelligence solution, LUMINAR, was named in the Social Media and Dark Web Monitoring category.


“A company’s risk now sits with its people as much as its network. Attackers exploit credentials and personal information leaked on the deep and dark web and use them to impersonate executives and take over their accounts” said Gilad Zahavi, VP Threat Intelligence at Cognyte. “Security teams need intelligence that shows who is targeted, how, and what to do next. We believe being named as a Sample Vendor in the latest Gartner report reflects our focus on exactly that.”


Executive threat protection is becoming a discipline of its own. In our view, this research gives security leaders a clear way to approach it.


## What Is Executive Threat Protection?


Executive threat protection, also called digital executive protection, is the practice of detecting and stopping digital threats aimed at an organization’s executives and other high-profile people. It covers leaked credentials and personal data, impersonation, account takeover and deepfake-enabled fraud. Attackers target these leaders directly, often without breaching the corporate network at all.


## Why Does Executive Threat Protection Matter Now?


In our view, executive threat protection is becoming a strategic requirement for security leaders. The fastest way into a company now often runs through the people who lead it.
An executive’s name, face and voice are public. Their credentials and personal details often surface in breach dumps and underground forums long before the security team knows they are exposed.


According to Gartner, “Executives remain high-value targets due to their elevated administrative access and authority to approve significant capital movements. Traditional internal governance enforcing segregation of duties, multiparty authorization thresholds, and rigorous audit scrutiny provides an essential baseline, yet remains insufficient against sophisticated cyber and physical vectors.”


We see GenAI widening that gap. A short audio clip can be enough to clone a voice. A single leaked password can be enough to take over an account. Protecting executives now means watching where attackers prepare: outside the network.


## How LUMINAR Protects Executives from Digital Threats


LUMINAR is Cognyte’s AI-powered external threat intelligence solution that empowers security and risk management leaders with comprehensive visibility into their external threat landscape.


For executive protection specifically, LUMINAR enables security teams to:


- Monitor the[deep and dark web](https://www.cognyte.com/blog/dark-web-monitoring/) for exposed credentials, sensitive executive information and emerging threats targeting leadership.
- Detect and respond to impersonation that targets executives across media platforms and messaging platforms.
- Identify deepfake-enabled threats early.
- Conduct takedown operations to neutralize threats targeting executives and their organizations.


As threat actors increasingly leverage GenAI to carry out more sophisticated, faster-moving attacks, LUMINAR’s AI-driven analytics help security teams prioritize threats, filter out false positives, and act on contextualized intelligence. A designated analyst, the Intelligence Concierge, validates findings and recommends next steps.


## Recognized Again in Gartner Research


Cognyte was previously recognized as[a Sample Vendor in the 2025 Gartner® Emerging Tech Impact Radar: Preemptive Cybersecurity report](https://www.cognyte.com/blog/proactive-threat-intelligence-monitoring/) . LUMINAR was recognized as an example vendor in the[2024 Gartner® Emerging Tech: The Future of Cyberthreat Intelligence research](https://www.cognyte.com/blog/gartner-luminar-example-vendor/) We believe being named again in Gartner’s new research note, now for executive threat protection, reflects the breadth of LUMINAR’s threat intelligence capabilities.


## What This Means for Security Leaders


If you are a CISO, security operations leader or risk executive responsible for protecting your organization’s leadership, we feel the Gartner research provides a clear framework for evaluating the right mix of executive protection solutions.
This is a good opportunity to review which of the three categories your program covers, and whether your existing solutions offer deepfake detection and disinformation capabilities needed to address evolving threats.
